description: I shop a lot on Amazon, around 12k a month, and I have Prime. About 2,000 on Swiggy, 8,000 at local shops, 3k on bills and 3k on petrol.
Most of my money goes on food apps: 8,000 a month on Swiggy and 3,000 on Zomato. Another 4k on Myntra and Nykaa and 6k in shops. No Prime.
I pay my 30k rent by credit card. 25k a month in shops and restaurants, 15k other online shopping, 5k on Flipkart, about 72k a year on flights and hotels, 4k bills and 5k fuel.
Flipkart is my main shopping site, about 10k a month. I spend 15k in stores, 4k on fuel and pay 24k a year in insurance premiums.
Light user: 3k on Amazon (Prime member), 2k on Flipkart, 3k on other apps and websites, 5k in shops each month.
